verification.independent_reader: A second agent separately inspected the original rendered table and the generated CIF; all central values, printed uncertainties, negative fractional coordinates and the U/100 conversion agreed.
verification.method: Parse generated CIF independently with pymatgen and larixite, enumerate first-shell N neighbors, check3+1 distances against Table3 to5e-5Å printed rounding tolerance. No adjustment of geometry to match Table3.

conditions.evidence: Neither diffraction T/P nor a numerical crystal-growth condition was identified in pp815–819; no ambient conditions inferred. p818 acknowledgements identify Siemens/Philips supply, not conditions.

rights.status: Locally authored transcription of published numeric crystallographic facts with full attribution; not an original publisher CIF and not a COD-licensed artifact.
rights.article_rights: Publisher article copyright/licensing remains separate; no PDF or page image included in deliverable.
rights.note: No claim that the publisher placed the article or its crystallographic facts under CC0.

limitations: The space-group number and unit occupancies are explicit encodings of the published wurtzite stoichiometric model, not separately printed/refined parameters.
Coordinates/cell are experimental and unchanged; no ideal wurtzite u=.375 substitution, cell rescaling or bond equalization.
The isotropic U column is preserved in CIF for fidelity; native FEFF uses average geometry and must not treat these values as a validated EXAFS Debye-Waller factor.
No XAS measurement or experimental EXAFS validation is provided.
